answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a bonded identity ladder. An agent posts a bond sized to its claimed reputation, held in slow escrow, before it may submit or grade. Many identities therefore need many independently funded, locked wallets, so a glacier of fakes grows slowly: capital stays idle for the whole lock. If a cluster fabricates work, an audit can slash every member at once, costing the full budget in one verdict. Reputation from a wharf of real deliveries compounds and does not transfer, and a prism of clones flags cheaply. Once the fine exceeds the reward, identities stop paying.
